title: Гроза над тихим озером

shots.prompt: Locked-off vertical wide shot from under a covered wooden terrace roof, deep focus, clean dry lens, real location footage at late dusk. A thin curtain of rain drips from the roof gutter across the top of the frame, and wet dark green leafy branches hang motionless into the left edge, beads of water trembling on the leaves. A heavy blue-grey sky with low storm clouds fills the upper third above wooded hills dissolving into grey rain mist. The middle holds the dark lake dimpled by steady rain and, on the far shore, an empty wet asphalt road with a short open stretch between two dense dark tree stands. The frame stays perfectly still. In the final second, two tiny warm amber headlights of one small dark hatchback emerge from behind the left tree stand onto the open stretch, casting a faint amber glint on the wet asphalt. Soft, even, cool blue-grey overcast light, slate tones, deep wet greens. Sound: heavy raindrops drumming deep and steady on the wooden terrace roof right overhead, fat drops splashing into the lake and slapping broad wet leaves, and water dripping from the gutter in thick, heavy plops onto wet wood. A low wet gust breathes through the trees. In the final second, a faint low wet tyre rumble on asphalt begins far across the lake.
shots.beat: Hook, cut, 5 s: locked-off vertical wide shot from under the terrace roof of the dark lake, misty wooded hills and the empty wet road on the far shore, with branches at the left edge and roof drips at the top under steady rain. In the last second, two small warm amber headlights emerge from behind the left tree stand onto the open stretch of road. Sound: steady rain on lake, leaves and roof, close gutter drips.

direction.start: Loop anchor composition. Storm sky fills the upper third. The dark rain-dimpled lake and the empty wet far-shore road between two dense tree stands sit in the middle, with the near shore below. Wet dark branches hang in from the left edge in a resting pose, and roof drips fall along the top. Steady medium rain, even dusk light.
direction.action: Rain falls steadily and the scene holds. In the final second, two tiny amber headlights of one small hatchback emerge from behind the left tree stand onto the open stretch of road.
direction.camera: Locked-off tripod, vertical wide shot from under the terrace roof, deep focus, clean lens; no movement.
direction.end: Identical composition. The small car's headlights have just appeared at the left end of the open road stretch, and a faint amber glint shows on the wet asphalt.

shots.prompt: A locked-off vertical wide shot continues beneath a covered wooden terrace at dusk, with deep focus and a clean dry lens. Wet dark green branches hang still along the left edge, and rain drips from the gutter above. The dark lake is dimpled by steady rain beneath wooded hills softened by grey mist. Across the lake, one tiny dark hatchback with warm amber headlights drives left to right along a short open stretch of wet road between two dense tree stands. Its small amber reflection glides beneath it. Midway through the clip, a brief cold-white flash illuminates the interior of one distant blue-grey cloud, then the sky returns to even dusk light. The car disappears completely behind the right tree stand, leaving the road empty. The camera remains still; slate blue and deep wet green colors stay natural. Sound: heavy raindrops keep drumming deep and steady on the wooden terrace roof, fat drops splash into the lake and slap broad wet leaves, and water drips from the gutter in thick, heavy plops onto wet wood. Far across the lake, the car's low wet tyre rumble on asphalt rolls past and recedes behind the trees. A low wet gust moves through the branches, and with the flash, deep rolling thunder begins far away, a soft low rumble building beneath the rain.
shots.beat: Continue, 5 s, same static frame: the small dark hatchback calmly crosses the open stretch left to right, its amber headlights streaking reflections on the wet asphalt. Midway, one short cold-white flash glows inside a distant cloud in the upper third. The car slips fully behind the right tree stand by the final frame, leaving the road empty. Sound: rain, faint tyre hiss, then the first low edge of a muffled thunder roll.

direction.start: Identical locked-off composition to the end of clip 1. The two tiny warm amber headlights of the one small dark hatchback have just appeared at the left end of the open far-shore road stretch, with a faint amber glint on the wet asphalt. Branches hang still in from the left edge, roof drips fall at the top, steady rain, even dusk light.
direction.action: The hatchback drives calmly left to right across the short open stretch, and a soft amber reflection glides on the wet road. Midway through the clip, one brief cold-white flash glows inside a single distant low cloud, then the cloud returns to even grey. The car slips fully behind the right tree stand.
direction.camera: Locked-off tripod, vertical wide shot from under the terrace roof, deep focus, clean lens; no movement.
direction.end: Identical composition with the far-shore road empty again. The sky is back to even blue-grey dusk light, rain continues and the branches hang still in their resting pose. A distant muffled thunder roll is just beginning.

shots.prompt: The locked-off vertical wide shot continues from under a covered wooden terrace roof, deep focus, clean dry lens, real location footage at late dusk. The wet asphalt road on the far shore lies empty along its short open stretch between two dense dark tree stands, shining with a cool silver rain sheen. A heavy blue-grey sky with low storm clouds fills the upper third, even and calm above wooded hills dissolving into grey rain mist. The dark lake in the middle stays dimpled by steady rain. A thin curtain of rain drips from the roof gutter across the top of the frame. Wet dark green leafy branches hang still into the left edge in the same resting pose throughout, with only beads of water trembling and dripping from the leaves. The frame holds perfectly still to the final second in soft, even, cool blue-grey overcast light, with slate tones and deep wet greens. Sound: the deep rolling thunder keeps rumbling softly far away and slowly fades to nothing. Heavy raindrops keep drumming deep and steady on the wooden terrace roof, fat drops splash into the lake and slap broad wet leaves, and water drips from the gutter in thick, heavy plops onto wet wood. A low wet gust breathes through the trees, and the shot ends on only the steady drumming rain, heavy gutter drips and the low gust.
shots.beat: Continue, 5 s, same static frame: the road stays empty and the sky is back to even blue-grey dusk. The muffled thunder roll rumbles low and fades into steady rain. The branches settle into their resting pose and the composition, light and rain match the opening frame exactly for the loop. Sound: fading distant thunder, constant rain and gutter drips carrying through the join.

direction.start: Exact last frame of act 2. The wet far-shore road is empty after the hatchback has slipped behind the right tree stand, and the sky has returned to even blue-grey dusk after the flash. Branches hang still at the left edge in their resting pose, roof drips fall at the top, and steady rain continues.
direction.action: Nothing new happens on screen. Rain keeps falling, water beads drip from the still branches, and the distant thunder rumbles and fades into steady rain.
direction.camera: Locked-off tripod, vertical wide shot from under the terrace roof, deep focus, clean lens; no movement or reframing.
direction.end: The loop anchor composition, identical to the opening frame. The storm sky fills the upper third, the dark rain-dimpled lake and the empty wet road sit between two tree stands, and the branches rest at the left edge. Roof drips fall at the top under even dusk light and steady medium rain.

logline: С укрытой террасы виден дождливый сумеречный пейзаж: по дальнему берегу тёмного озера проезжает одна маленькая машина, в далёкой туче коротко вспыхивает молния, и всё возвращается к прежнему спокойному виду.
synopsis: Неподвижный вертикальный общий план с укрытой деревянной террасы. Видны тёмное озеро, лесистые холмы в дождевом тумане и пустая мокрая дорога на дальнем берегу. В конце первого клипа слева на дороге появляется маленькая машина с тёплыми янтарными фарами. Во втором клипе она спокойно пересекает открытый участок, свет фар отражается на мокром асфальте. В середине клипа внутри далёкой тучи коротко вспыхивает молния, затем доносится приглушённый раскат грома. Машина скрывается за деревьями, гром затихает в третьем клипе, и пейзаж под ровным дождём возвращается к исходному кадру с пустой дорогой.

style.visual: Real location footage of a rainy lakeside dusk, filmed from under a covered terrace in a locked-off vertical frame: quiet, documentary-true, meditative.
style.palette: Blue-grey slate for the sky, mist and lake surface; deep wet dark green for the trees and the framing branches; near-black asphalt with silver rain sheen; small warm amber accents only from the distant headlights and their reflections.
style.lens: Moderate wide 28-35mm feel, deep focus from the near branches to the far hills, clean dry lens, fine natural texture with subtle film-like grain, no blur effects.
style.lighting: Late dusk under heavy overcast: soft, even, cool blue-grey ambient light. The only warm source is the car's small amber headlights. One brief cold-white flash glows inside a distant cloud mid-piece.
style.camera: Completely static tripod shot under the roof: one unchanging composition for all 15 seconds, no zoom or reframing.
style.sound: Heavy raindrops drumming on the wooden terrace roof, fat drops splashing into the lake and slapping broad wet leaves, gutter water dripping onto wood, a low wet gust in the trees, one deep rolling thunder that rumbles and fades. No music, no voices.
style.pace: Three seamless 5-second segments of one continuous take. Events are minimal and spaced out: car appears, crosses with the lightning, thunder fades back into constant rain.

locations.name: Rainy lake view from the covered terrace
locations.descriptor: the view from under a covered wooden terrace roof onto a dark rain-dimpled lake, a wet asphalt road along the far shore between dense dark green tree stands, and wooded hills fading into grey rain mist under a low blue-grey storm sky, with wet dark branches hanging in from the left edge

request: Эстетичный вертикальный зацикленный дождливый пейзаж с грозой: неподвижный вид с укрытой террасы на тёмное озеро, лесистые холмы в дождевом тумане и мокрую дорогу на дальнем берегу. Одна небольшая машина проезжает далеко по дороге, тёплые фары отражаются на асфальте. Одна короткая молния внутри далёкой тучи, затем приглушённый раскат грома. Настоящая натурная съёмка, медитативная атмосфера, как красивый атмосферный TikTok.

must_keep: Exactly three consecutive 5-second clips: first transition cut, second and third continue
One continuous locked-off wide shot from under a covered terrace roof: no angle change, no zoom, no camera move
Clean lens, deep focus, natural texture of foliage and rain
Dark lake, wooded hills in rain mist, wet road on the far shore
Sky in the upper third, lake and road in the middle, wet dark branches framing the view at the side
Dusk blue-grey light, dark green trees, small amber headlights
Road is empty at the start
Exactly one small car: appears at the end of clip 1, calmly crosses a short open stretch of road in clip 2, fully disappears behind trees before clip 3 begins
Warm headlights reflect on the wet asphalt
Exactly one short lightning flash inside a distant cloud, only in the middle of clip 2, followed by a muffled thunder roll that fades during clip 3
Continuous rain and steady ambient noise across all joins
Final frame identical to the first: empty road, same light, same branch pose, same composition
Real location footage look, meditative mood
avoid: Change of angle, zoom, any camera movement
Water drops or smears on the lens
Fades, titles or an ending beat
assumptions: The framing branches hang from the left edge of the frame. Their leaves only drip and tremble slightly, so their pose can match at the loop point.
The car drives left to right and enters from a gap in the trees at the left end of the open stretch.
A thin line of rain dripping from the roof edge runs along the top of the frame as foreground texture, kept in deep focus.
The far shore is roughly 1-2 km away, so the car reads as small and slow.
Rain is steady and medium, with no gusts, so the scene state stays constant for the loop.
No characters: the car is a prop and its driver is never visible.
visual_anchors: the covered wooden terrace edge with a thin curtain of rain dripping from the roof gutter across the top of the frame
wet dark green leafy branches hanging into the left edge of the frame, beads of water trembling on the leaves
the dark still lake dimpled by rain across the middle of the frame
the wet two-lane asphalt road running along the far shore, with a short open stretch between two dense dark tree stands
wooded hills dissolving into grey rain mist behind the far shore
a heavy blue-grey dusk sky with low storm clouds filling the upper third
one small dark hatchback with two warm amber headlights, tiny in the distance
dusk blue-grey overcast light, soft and even, no direct sun
creative_brief.loop_anchor: Locked-off vertical wide shot from under the terrace roof: upper third is the blue-grey storm sky, the middle holds the dark rain-dimpled lake and the empty wet road on the far shore between two tree stands, and the bottom holds the near shore. Wet dark branches hang in from the left edge in a resting pose and roof drips fall at the top. Steady medium rain, no car, no lightning, even dusk light.
creative_brief.project_notes: Ровно три последовательных клипа по 5 секунд, один непрерывный неподвижный общий план: первый cut, следующие continue. Камера под крышей, объектив чистый, глубокая резкость, натуральная фактура листвы и дождя. Сумеречный сине-серый свет, тёмно-зелёные деревья, небольшие янтарные фары. Никакого неона, текста, речи, музыки, смены ракурса, зума, людей или сюрреализма. В начале дорога пуста. Машина появляется в конце первого клипа, спокойно пересекает небольшой открытый участок дороги во втором и полностью скрывается за деревьями до начала третьего. Молния только в середине второго клипа, гром затихает в третьем. В конце та же пустая дорога, тот же свет, поза ветвей и неизменная композиция, что в начале; дождь и ровный фоновый шум продолжаются через стык. Небо занимает верхнюю треть, озеро и дорога середину, мокрые тёмные ветви сбоку обрамляют пейзаж. Финальная сцена возвращается к первому кадру. Не растягивать действие: один автомобиль, одна далёкая вспышка.

review_notes: 002: убрано «headlights streaking amber reflections». Слово «streaking» провоцирует световые шлейфы и смаз, а это противоречит требованию натурной съёмки. Теперь отражение спокойно скользит по мокрому асфальту.

002: вспышка ограничена одним далёким облаком. Убрана подсветка тумана над холмами, чтобы вспышка оставалась короткой и далёкой, как в запросе, а не превращалась в засветку всего кадра. В звук добавлен стук дождя по листьям для ровности фонового шума через стыки.

003: устранено противоречие по ветвям. В 001 и 002 они неподвижны, а в 003 была придумана «дрожь, которая затихает». Теперь ветви весь клип в одной позе, дрожат и капают только капли. Это надёжнее для совпадения позы на стыке петли.
001 корректен и не изменён: пустая дорога, фары только в последнюю секунду, чистый объектив, неподвижная камера.

Риск: проезд машины от левого края открытого участка до полного исчезновения за правыми деревьями за ~5 с требует очень короткого участка дороги. Модель может не успеть увести машину целиком. Если в кадре 002 машина останется видна, нужен перерендер 002, иначе разорвётся стык с 003 и петлёй.
Проверено: 5.042 с — 121 кадр, допустимая сетка LTX 8k+1. Промпт второй сцены сокращён без изменения действия.
